scripts.dev: docker compose up -d && wait-on tcp:5432 && concurrently --names "next,server" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" "pnpm --dir nextjs run dev" "pnpm --dir server run start"
scripts.test:gameplay:parity: pnpm --dir server run test shared/communication/protocol.parity.test.ts server/model/rooms/room.fixture-parity.test.ts && cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:server && pnpm run lint:nextjs && pnpm run lint:mobile
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm run lint:fix:server && pnpm run lint:fix:nextjs && pnpm run lint:fix:mobile
